label.zh: 异常调查后约30%概率得到线索
label.en: About 30% of anomaly follow-ups yield a clue

bridges.evidence: common/scripted_effects/00_scripted_effects.txt:3291 pop_lcluster_event (random 7 nothing / 3 → country_event distar.9000 days 10) is called by many anomaly outcomes; it needs has_distar, encountered_first_lgate and a chain whose 7 clues are not complete (events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1140).

common/scripted_effects/00_scripted_effects.txt:3243 generate_lcluster_clue: each clue adds to the l_cluster_chain counter 'clues' (max 7, common/event_chains/00_event_chains_distant_stars.txt:27) and when it is complete fires distar.10904 (events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1280). Clues also come from the repeatable tech tech_repeatable_lcluster_clue (distar.12000) and many anomaly/event options.

label.zh: 研究“星门激活”科技且拥有L-星门
label.en: Research the L-Gate activation tech while owning an L-Gate

bridges.evidence: common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:2698 on_tech_increased → distar.10903 (hidden: last_increased_tech = tech_lgate_activation, l_cluster not opened) → distar.10900 (hidden): owns_lgate_megastructure → enable_lgate_project_on_owned_gateway → distar.10905 (events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1196-1213, common/scripted_effects/00_scripted_effects.txt:3468).

label.zh: 研究该科技但没有L-星门
label.en: Research the tech without owning an L-Gate

bridges.evidence: events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1207-1212 distar.10900 else → distar.10901 "L-Gate Needed"; option a re-checks every 60 days through hidden distar.10902 until a gate is owned, option b liquidates the clues for resources.

label.zh: 邻国已收集超过5条线索并拥有L-星门
label.en: A neighbour has more than 5 clues and owns an L-Gate

bridges.evidence: common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:107 on_monthly_pulse → distar.10955 (hidden, events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1498-1566): a human player with the chain or project has communications with a country with chain, num_lcluster_clues > 5 and an lgate_base; that player then gets distar.10956 once per warned country.

label.zh: 科学船抵达幼龙所在恒星
label.en: A science ship reaches the star where a young L-Drake waits

bridges.evidence: common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1026 on_entering_system_fleet → distar.13030 (events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:2082): a science ship enters a dragon_point system holding a baby nanite space dragon the owner has not visited; option a (not homicidal, not fanatic xenophobe) starts TAME_LDRAGON_PROJECT.

common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1463 on_ship_destroyed_perp → distar.13020 (events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:2009): the destroyed ship belongs to a country of type ldragon_country; the reward is larger if the L-Drake was already known (ldragon_known).

label.zh: 开启后的结局（开局已决定）
label.en: Outcome after opening (decided at game start)

note.zh: 开局事件 distar.8000 在启用L-星门时随机：50（若禁用破坏性玩法则为0）灰色风暴危机、30无事、30龙之季、30灰雾帝国（events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1109-1129）；distar.10950 按全局标志选择 graygoo.1 / distar.13000 / graygoo.100 / distar.10951。
note.en: The game-start event distar.8000 rolls when L-Gates are enabled: 50 gray goo crisis (0 if disruptive gameplay is blocked), 30 nothing, 30 dragon season, 30 gray goo empire (events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1109-1129); distar.10950 then picks graygoo.1 / distar.13000 / graygoo.100 / distar.10951 by the global flag.

note.zh: 无危机的结局：L-星团开放，其他L-星门之后每200-700天陆续启用（distar.10960）。
note.en: The quiet ending: the cluster is open and other L-Gates activate one by one every 200-700 days (distar.10960).

note.zh: 项目完成后，该恒星系归你所有。
note.en: After the project the system is yours.

scope.zh: L-星团主线（发现、线索、研究、项目、四种结局入口、龙之季后续）已核对；各线索来源的具体异常逐一列出（约20处）未逐条验证，灰色风暴与灰雾帝国分支属其他故事。
scope.en: The main L-Cluster line (discovery, clues, research, project, entries of the four outcomes, dragon-season follow-up) is checked; the individual clue-giving anomalies (about 20) were not verified one by one, and the Gray Tempest / gray goo empire branches belong to other stories.

uncertain: The roughly 20 events that call generate_lcluster_clue / pop_lcluster_event (anomalies, distar.12000 tech, artifact action, crisis.8060 etc.) are summarised as one bridge from the chain, not listed individually; their gates (e.g. crisis.8060 requires has_event_chain = l_cluster_chain) were not each verified.
apoc.3 (surveyed L-Gate) starts the same chain in another story (event-apoc-3); the two entries are described together in the guide but only distar.13080 is in this story.
